column1: # VST2 → VST3 of the same plugin in Live sets — read by src/vst2to3.rs.
# One row per plugin; where each came from and what was checked: docs/plugins.md.
# vst2: VST2 unique ID (4 characters). vst3: class ID as Live writes it (FUID, 32 hex digits).
# io: how Live writes the VST3 — fx (1 in, 1 out), fx-stereo (2 in, 1 out), synth (0 in, 1 out).
# state: how the VST3 holds the VST2's state — as-is, vstw, length-prefixed, fabfilter, vstw-params
# status: verified (re-saved by Live, state equal to the plugin's own VST3) is on by default;
